info.title: Todos API
info.description:
The classic Todos API, used to demonstrate one contract consumed by a
service, a React UI, a CLI and an MCP server.

get.description: Returns a page of todos, optionally filtered by status and priority.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items per page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page's nextCursor.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer to the offending field, e.g. /title.

rule.description: The CEL rule that failed (semantic errors only).

post.description: Long-running: archives every done todo in the background. Answers 202 with an Operation to poll; its result says how many todos were archived.

202.description: Long-running: the work continues in the background. Poll the Operation at Location (also its href) until status is succeeded or failed.

Location.description: URL of the Operation to poll.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before polling again, or before retrying after a 429.

oauth2.description: OAuth2 / OIDC from the platform's identity provider. The web UI signs the user in (authorization code + PKCE); the CLI, MCP server and CI use client credentials in this demo (in production: device flow for the CLI, the MCP authorization spec for agents). The API checks the same token and scopes whichever client sent it.
